risk: Agent sends customer email addresses to an external model
mitigation: Block personal data fields before the prompt is sent and log every call

risk: Monthly model spend doubles without warning
mitigation: Set a monthly budget alert at 80 percent and a hard cap per cost center

risk: Agent edits a production database without approval
mitigation: Require human approval for every write and limit the agent to read only tools by default

risk: Model gives wrong answers about pricing and refunds
mitigation: Test answers against a fixed sample each week and route low confidence replies to a human

risk: Customer data kept in a dataset past its agreed retention date
mitigation: Add a retention date to every dataset row and review expired entries monthly

risk: Team keeps using a retired model because old prompts still point at it
mitigation: Keep one list of approved models and remove retired ones from every config
